text:
Ava: Starting thread — need the benchmark launch playbook. Goal: clarify latency vs cost narrative, two chart specs, headline copy, webinar hook, and inbound routing rules.
Diego: Agreed. Central narrative: "Predictable unit economics for inference". Show how orchestration (routing + batching + caching) shifts points into the low-cost + in-SLO quadrant.
Maya: Chart ideas:
1) Scatter: x=p95 latency (ms), y=cost per 1k tokens. Points = model variants (baseline, quantized, cached). Add dashed vertical line at p95 SLO (e.g., 120ms) and horizontal band for target cost.
2) Stacked bar: x=workload slice (chat, embed, batch), stacks = gpu, infra, cache savings, network. Show net cost per 1M tokens.
Sam: For scatter, annotate a quadrant "Win: in-SLO & in-budget" with a green halo. Keep colors accessible. Use normalized cost (cost/1k tokens) not raw dollars.
Ava: Diego — can you write a minimal chart spec we hand to design? Keep it simple.
Diego: Sure. Sketch:
```chart
# Scatter
x: p95_latency_ms
y: cost_per_1k_tokens
series: baseline, quantized, cached
annotations: p95_SLO=120, target_cost_upper=0.75
visual: quadrant_highlight(on: lower-left)
# Stacked bar
x: workload_type
series: gpu_cost, infra_cost, cache_savings, network
normalize: per_1M_tokens
``` 
Maya: I'll turn that into Figma frames by Wed. Use label copy: "Cost per 1k tokens" and "p95 latency (ms)".
Jordan: Webinar hook: "Live demo: cut token costs 3x while keeping p95 <100ms — reproducible config + Q&A." Include a short live demo + downloadable configs.
Sam: Routing rules (HubSpot):
- Trial accounts with sustained qps >50 OR projected spend >$2k/mo -> Sales AE
- enterprise/compliance flags -> Enterprise AE
- Direct demo requests -> AE
- Webinar attendees with >50% watch time -> SDR nurture + follow-up email
Add optional signup field: "expected qps" to help routing.
Ava: Email subject A/B test:
A: "See how we cut inference spend 3x — live demo"
B: "Keep strict p95 SLOs while lowering token spend"
Split 50/50, track CTR and demo signups.
Maya: Design note: don't clutter; two visuals + 2 social cards. Provide CSVs for points.
Diego: I'll generate CSVs + a tiny notebook that plots the points and saves PNGs. Pushing to drive tonight.
ops-bot: created drive folder: https://drive.example.com/rdw/bench-launch and invited design/marketing :white_check_mark:
Ava: Action items:
- Maya: Figma frames for charts by Wed
- Diego: CSVs + notebook by Tue EOD
- Jordan: Webinar page + HubSpot routing rules
- Sam: 3-step demo script and config bundle draft by tomorrow
I'll assemble launch copy and timeline and send for review on Fri. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Maya: On it.
Diego: will upload tonight.
Sam: drafting script now.
Jordan: will configure routing and test leads.
